verdict.rationale: Gide has a documented Intellectual Property group page that lists patents among its areas. Its patent work as evidenced centres on litigation, including cross-border patent cases and Unified Patent Court pleading. Drafting and filing appears to be handled through a 30-year partnership with the outside industrial property firm Regimbeau rather than in-house, so prosecution relies on an external partner. Missing for 10: evidence of in-house patent drafting and filing, documented portfolio-strategy services, and named patent practitioners.
